B. Subject line

C. Body with details

questions.texte: Arrange the email parts in the correct order.

enonce.texte:
You work for a company in Douala. Write a professional email to your manager requesting a meeting to discuss a new project. Include:

  • A clear subject line
  • A polite greeting
  • The purpose of the email
  • Proposed dates and times
  • A closing and signature

questions.reponse:
Example answer: 
Subject: Request for Meeting to Discuss New Project
Dear Mr. Nanga,
I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to request a meeting to discuss the new project that we will be launching next month. I would like to go over the budget and timeline with you.
Would you be available on Wednesday at 2:00 PM or Thursday at 10:00 AM? Please let me know which time works best for you.
I look forward to your response.
Best regards,
Jean-Pierre Etoundi
Project Manager

enonce.texte:
Match the report section with its content.

  • 1. Executive Summary
  • 2. Introduction
  • 3. Findings
  • 4. Recommendations
  • 5. Conclusion

A. Overview of the report and main conclusions.

B. Background information and purpose of the report.

C. Data and results of the research.

D. Suggested actions to take based on findings.

E. Final thoughts and summary of the report.

questions.texte: Match each section with its correct description.

enonce.texte:
Find and correct the errors in this email.

Original:

"To whom it may concern,

I am writting to inquire about the job position of sales manager. I have experience in sales for 5 years. I think I am the best candidate for this job. Please contact me at your convenience. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regard,"

questions.reponse:
1. "writting" → "writing"
2. "position of" → "position for" or "position as"
3. "for 5 years" → "for 5 years" is correct, but could be "have had for 5 years"
4. "regard" → "regards"

enonce.texte:
A customer has sent a complaint email about a late delivery. Write a professional response email that:

  • Acknowledges the complaint
  • Apologizes sincerely
  • Explains the reason (without making excuses)
  • Offers a solution
  • Ends politely

questions.texte: Write a professional response to a complaint.
questions.reponse:
Example answer: 
Subject: Apology for Late Delivery
Dear Mr. Mvondo,
Thank you for your email. I am very sorry to hear about the delay in your delivery. I understand how frustrating this must be.
After checking with our logistics team, the delay was caused by an unexpected issue with our shipping partner. We are already working to resolve this for future orders.
To make up for the inconvenience, we would like to offer you a 10% discount on your next order. Please let us know if you would like us to resend the items.
We appreciate your understanding and patience.
Sincerely,
Marie Ngo
Customer Service Manager

enonce.texte:
Write a short business report (2 paragraphs) on one of these topics:

  • Improving customer service at a restaurant
  • Reducing energy costs in an office
  • Increasing sales in a shop

Include an introduction, findings, and recommendations.

questions.reponse: Example answer: Report on Reducing Energy Costs Introduction: The purpose of this report is to identify ways to reduce energy costs in our office. High energy bills have been a concern for the past six months. Findings: An analysis of our energy use shows that lights and air conditioners are the main sources of consumption. Many lights are left on overnight, and air conditioners are set to very low temperatures. Recommendations: We recommend installing motion-sensor lights and training staff to turn off equipment when not in use. We also suggest setting air conditioners to 24°C. These measures could reduce costs by up to 20%.

enonce.texte:
Write an email to a colleague asking them to prepare a report for an upcoming meeting. Include:

  • A friendly but professional tone
  • Clear instructions on what is needed
  • Deadline
  • Offer to help if needed

questions.texte: Write an email to a colleague.
questions.reponse:
Example answer: 
Subject: Report for Upcoming Meeting
Hi Jean,
I hope you're doing well.
I am writing to ask if you could prepare the sales report for our meeting next Friday. The report should include the sales figures for the last quarter and a comparison with our targets.
Could you please have it ready by Wednesday morning? If you need any help with the data or formatting, just let me know.
Thank you in advance.
Best,
Sophie
